categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: automotive parts manufacturing and civil engineering construction. The automotive parts segment, which accounts for over 99% of revenue, produces plastic injection molded and blow-molded interior and exterior automotive components such as crash pads, consoles, glove boxes, and luggage boards. The construction segment focuses on civil engineering projects but contributes less than 1% of total sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes plastic injection molding and blow hollow molding technologies to manufacture automotive interior and exterior parts. It emphasizes advanced molding techniques and modular assembly for large components. The company also invests in automated production lines and has a central technology research center to enhance product quality and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive manufacturers such as Hyundai, Kia, Hyundai Mobis, Volkswagen, Audi, BMW, GM, and regional subsidiaries like Hyundai Mobis Mexico. The company serves primarily the automotive OEM market, supplying first-tier parts for vehicle assembly. The construction segment serves public and private sector clients for civil infrastructure projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production facilities and subsidiaries in South Korea, China (Yancheng), Germany, Czech Republic, Spain, and Mexico. Sales are distributed mainly across domestic South Korea, Europe, Mexico, and China, with additional minor markets. It supplies automotive parts to customers in Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a first-tier automotive parts supplier, positioned midstream in the automotive supply chain. It manufactures and supplies components directly to OEMs for vehicle assembly. It also engages in construction contracting downstream for civil infrastructure projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include securing global price and quality competitiveness through early-stage design verification and intellectual property development. The company focuses on high value-added product development, eco-friendly materials, and production automation. R&D efforts target quality improvement, technology innovation, and responding to trends like electric vehicles and environmental regulations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through OEM product sales of automotive parts under contract manufacturing agreements. Sales channels include domestic and export sales, with additional revenue from aftermarket (A/S) parts and limited construction project contracts. The company also earns rental income from real estate holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly competitive automotive parts industry, facing domestic and international suppliers. It holds a strong position as a first-tier supplier to Hyundai/Kia and global OEMs like Volkswagen and BMW. Its competitive advantages include advanced molding technology, diversified global production, and recognized quality certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, consolidated revenue reached approximately KRW 649 billion, with automotive parts accounting for 99% of sales. The company showed a 5.7% revenue growth year-over-year and returned to operating profitability with an operating profit of KRW 4.5 billion. It maintains a substantial asset base exceeding KRW 622 billion and continues capacity expansions domestically and internationally to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced plastic automotive components with strong OEM relationships. Its value proposition includes modular product offerings, eco-friendly materials, and production automation to meet evolving automotive industry demands. It differentiates through global manufacturing footprint, continuous R&D, and recognized quality and innovation awards.
